invite.successTempPassword: {{email}} added. Share the password below — you won't see it again.

invite.revokeConfirm: Revoke {{email}}'s pending invite? They won't be able to use any link they already have.

teams.title: Teams
teams.description: Group members into teams to share resources at a broader scope than per-user.
teams.name: Name

teams.removeMemberDesc: They lose access to anything shared via this team's membership. They remain in the organization.
teams.emptyDescAdmin: Create a team to start grouping members.
teams.emptyDescMember: Ask an organization admin to create a team.

org.title: Organization
org.description: Members and metadata for this instance.
org.nonAdminHint: Showing members you share a team with. Use the share-by-email flow to grant access to anyone else in the organization.
org.removeMemberDesc: They lose access to the entire organization and all resources shared with them through it. This is not reversible without re-adding them.
